Name: Ashriel, Son of Manasseh
Summary: Son of Manasseh, named among the sons of Manasseh.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:14: Son of Manasseh, named among the sons of Manasseh.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ashriel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
